title: Exam Oracle learning profile (a proposal extracted from a student's self-description)
description: Produced by B's oracle/students.py extract_learning_profile (rules_v1 offline, llm_v1 when LLM_API_KEY is set) and by C's RocketRide pipeline with the same prompt (contracts/student.md section 7). It is a PROPOSAL shown as confirm chips: nothing in it is applied until the student confirms. Every non-null value carries evidence, a verbatim quote of at most 120 characters from the cleaned self-description; a value without a quote is not allowed. schema_version, extractor and source_text_sha256 are filled by code, never by the LLM: the LLM output schema is this schema without those three properties.

source_text_sha256.description: SHA-256 (hex) of the cleaned text, UTF-8: the exact text stored in HydraDB memory s<n>_self

goals.description: What the student wants to achieve, as short statements. Instruction-like text is dropped.

accommodations.description: Neutral teaching adjustments ONLY, chosen from this fixed list; never the condition, diagnosis or disability. sensitive is always true: shown only to the student and stored only in the student's own collection.

enum: Allow extra time and avoid timed drills
Teach in short chunks with a brief recap after each
Use short sentences and clear formatting, not dense text
Do not rely on color alone and label every line in diagrams
Use a calm, encouraging tone and build difficulty gradually
Give written text for any audio or video

weekly_hours.description: Optional; present only when the text states it.

exam_date.description: Optional; present only when the text states an ISO date.
